al-ghadeer-gardens:
Al Ghadeer Gardens is Aldar's townhouse and villa collection within Al Ghadeer, a well-established, walkable community that sits directly on the Abu Dhabi-Dubai border, close enough to Dubai for a genuine daily commute, yet priced and planned like an Abu Dhabi suburb rather than a Dubai one.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Aldar Properties in Al Ghadeer, Abu Dhabi
• Curated collection of 2BR Townhouse, 3BR Townhouse, 4BR Villa
• Starting from approximately AED 1.7M
• Handover targeted for Q4 2029
• Signature amenities including Community parks, Retail strip, Schools nearby

### Architecture & Signature Residences

Aldar is Abu Dhabi's dominant master developer, the emirate's equivalent of what Emaar represents in Dubai, and Al Ghadeer has been one of its most consistently popular affordable-family plays for several years now, this newest phase extends a community that's already proven itself with prior releases rather than launching cold. For end-users, this is a straightforward family-villa play: real space, an established (not speculative) community, and a developer with Aldar's balance sheet and delivery record behind it. Q4 2029 handover gives buyers a reasonably long runway to plan around, whether that's saving toward the balance or lining up tenants ahead of completion.

• Community parks
• Retail strip
• Schools nearby
• Mosques
• Cycling paths
• Kids play areas

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 5% on initial booking
• 50% payable during construction
• 45% due upon handover

The payment plan is correspondingly conservative: 5% on booking, 50% during construction, and 45% on handover, a structure that puts real weight on the handover payment, meaning buyers commit a smaller amount upfront and settle a substantial portion only once the home is actually complete and ready to move into, which reduces the risk of paying heavily into a project that stalls. For investors, the appeal is similarly grounded, Al Ghadeer has built a reputation as one of the more affordable, reliably-occupied family-villa entry points in the wider Abu Dhabi-Dubai corridor, and this newest phase is aimed squarely at buyers chasing that value and occupancy stability rather than speculative capital appreciation or ultra-luxury finishes.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

The 437-unit release adds two- and three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas to a district that already has its own parks, retail strip, mosques and schools running, which matters more than it might sound: buyers moving into Al Ghadeer Gardens join a neighbourhood with amenities already operating day to day, not a masterplan still waiting for its first residents to arrive before shops and schools open. What makes Al Ghadeer Gardens worth serious consideration alongside Dubai's own affordable-villa communities is the value proposition on a like-for-like basis: townhouse and villa product at this price point is increasingly hard to find within Dubai's own borders, and Al Ghadeer's cross-border position means residents can genuinely access both emirates' job markets and lifestyle offerings without being locked into one or the other. The community's own retail strip, schools and mosques mean day-to-day life doesn't require a drive into central Dubai or central Abu Dhabi for basics, while weekend and work commutes in either direction remain realistic.
alana-the-valley:
Alana is one of the newer residential clusters within Emaar's expansive The Valley masterplan on the Dubai-Al Ain Road, a family-first community built on a simple premise: trade city density for space, greenery and a genuine sense of neighbourhood without leaving Dubai's commuter radius. The Valley itself is one of Emaar's most ambitious suburban bets, an AED25 billion, 200-hectare masterplan built out in named clusters (Eden, Nara, Rivana, Farm Gardens, Avena and more), each released in stages with its own character and price point.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Emaar Properties in The Valley
• Curated collection of 3BR Townhouse, 4BR Villa
• Handover targeted for Not yet announced
• Signature amenities including Community parks, Retail plaza, Cycling & walking trails

### Architecture & Signature Residences

Alana sits among the more recent of these, offering three- and four-bedroom townhouses and villas designed for growing households who want room to breathe: private gardens, dedicated parking, and layouts built around family living rather than maximising saleable area. What sets The Valley apart from Dubai's other suburban masterplans is the sheer scale of shared infrastructure already delivered rather than promised. The Golden Beach lagoon anchors the community as a genuine leisure destination, not just a rendering, residents already use it for weekend swims and picnics. A Town Centre retail hub handles daily errands without a drive to the mall, and a dedicated Sports Village is steadily adding padel courts, cricket nets and skate facilities as later phases complete. Cycling and jogging trails connect the clusters to each other, meaning a family in Alana isn't isolated from the rest of the masterplan's amenities, everything Emaar has built and is still building across The Valley is effectively on the doorstep. For end-users, Alana offers a rare combination in Dubai: villa-scale living, a masterplan with real amenities already operating, and Emaar's own delivery track record, all at a price point still meaningfully below Arabian Ranches or Dubai Hills equivalents. Alana, as a newer cluster, offers a chance to get in before that same maturation plays out again.

• Community parks
• Retail plaza
• Cycling & walking trails
• Swimming pools
• Kids play areas
• Nearby schools

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 10% on initial booking
• 80% payable during construction
• 10% due upon handover

The payment structure here is typical Emaar: 10% on booking, 80% spread across the construction period, and a modest 10% due on handover, a plan that front-loads less risk onto the buyer than many of the steeper 20/50/30 structures seen elsewhere in Dubai, since the bulk of payments track the actual pace of construction rather than a single large milestone. For investors, the appeal is similar, The Valley has consistently been one of Emaar's best-selling suburban brands since launch, and clusters that released early have already seen solid capital appreciation as the surrounding infrastructure matured.
alta-view-skyhomes:
Alta V1ew Skyhomes is a 55-storey, 499-unit tower in Jumeirah Village Circle from Object 1, full name Object One Real Estate Development, part of the broader TSZ Group, a developer known for a distinctive naming convention that swaps the letter 'i' for the numeral '1' across its entire portfolio, seen consistently in projects like W1NNER, OZONE1, V1TER Residence, 1WOOD Residence, LUM1NAR Towers, and EVERGR1N House alongside this one.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Object 1 in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC)
• Curated collection of Studio, 1BR Apartment, 2BR Apartment
• Starting from approximately AED 748K
• Handover targeted for Dec 2028
• Signature amenities including Indoor & outdoor pools, Spa, Fitness centre

### Architecture & Signature Residences

Featuring contemporary architecture, generous floorplans, expansive private balconies, and premium interior specifications designed for elegant modern living.

• Indoor & outdoor pools
• Spa
• Fitness centre
• Rooftop lounge
• Kids play areas
• Retail nearby

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 20% on initial booking
• 50% payable during construction
• 30% due upon handover

The payment plan runs an evenly balanced 20% on booking, 50% during construction and 30% on handover, though an alternative post-handover variant is also offered: 20% on booking, 50% during construction, a light 5% at handover, and the remaining 25% paid post-handover across five instalments, useful for buyers who want to extend their financial commitment beyond the completion date rather than settling the full balance immediately at handover. Starting from around AED 748,000, with handover targeted for December 2028 (though some sources cite an earlier Q3 2027 date, suggesting some variation across unit types or reporting sources), Alta V1ew Skyhomes competes with dozens of similarly-priced JVC towers primarily on the strength of its amenity package and rooftop offering. JVC itself has become one of Dubai's highest-volume investor markets specifically because of its consistently strong rental yields relative to purchase price, a dynamic that's held reasonably steady even as unit supply in the area has grown substantially over recent years. For buyers specifically evaluating JVC as a rental-yield play rather than a lifestyle destination, Object 1's distinctive branding and above-average amenity provision, the indoor/outdoor pool combination and rooftop lounge in particular exceed what many competing JVC towers offer at a similar price point, give Alta V1ew Skyhomes a genuine, if modest, edge within an otherwise densely competitive and increasingly commoditised segment of the market.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

Studio to two-bedroom apartments come with indoor and outdoor pools, a spa, a fitness centre, a rooftop lounge and kids' play areas, positioning the tower as a design-forward but genuinely accessible option within JVC's now extremely dense apartment market, one of Dubai's highest-volume investor districts, where dozens of competing towers from many different developers now compete primarily on amenity package and finish quality rather than location alone, since virtually all JVC towers share broadly similar proximity to the same schools, retail and road access.
alva-at-the-valley:
Alva at The Valley is a new residential development by Emaar Properties in Al Yufrah 1, Dubai, offering a limited collection of contemporary 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses within a nature-inspired master-planned community.

Designed for families seeking spacious homes, greenery, and a peaceful suburban lifestyle, Alva combines modern architecture with landscaped surroundings, open spaces, and a comprehensive range of family-focused amenities. The townhouses feature modern façades, open-plan interiors, large windows, private outdoor spaces, thoughtful family-oriented layouts, and contemporary finishes designed to enhance natural light and indoor-outdoor living. Residents benefit from the extensive amenities across The Valley, including Golden Beach, Sports Village, Kids' play areas, jogging and cycling tracks, outdoor fitness zones, landscaped parks, picnic areas, pocket parks, community retail and dining outlets, the Town Centre, and various recreational and leisure spaces.

• Central A/C

The Valley continues to attract homeowners and investors seeking larger residences, green surroundings, and a self-contained community environment, while Alva's off-plan positioning and expected handover around 2030, subject to the developer's final delivery schedule, provide an opportunity to participate in the continued growth of this emerging Dubai destination.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

Located along Dubai to Al Ain Road, The Valley provides convenient connectivity to major destinations across Dubai while maintaining a tranquil environment away from the city's busy urban core, with Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, Dubai Outlet Mall, and key business districts within accessible reach. As an Emaar development within one of Dubai's growing suburban communities, Alva offers freehold ownership, modern townhouse living, strong connectivity, and access to a lifestyle designed around nature, wellness, and family recreation.
amali-residences:
Amali Residences is a 48-storey, roughly 211-home canal-front tower in Al Wasl from boutique developer Amali Properties, built around a genuinely rare concept for the Dubai market: double-height 'Sky Villa' units complete with their own private pools and terraces, stacked partway up a high-rise tower rather than confined to the building's uppermost penthouse level the way most Dubai towers handle premium units. Two- to four-bedroom apartments, duplexes and Sky Penthouses sit alongside these Sky Villas, all overlooking the Dubai Water Canal with sightlines toward Downtown Dubai and Safa Park.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Amali Properties in Al Wasl, Dubai Water Canal
• Curated collection of 2BR Apartment, 3BR Duplex, 4BR Sky Penthouse, Sky Villa
• Starting from approximately AED 10M
• Handover targeted for Q4 2029
• Signature amenities including Private pools (Sky Villas), Indoor & outdoor pools, Yoga & Pilates studio

### Architecture & Signature Residences

Amali Properties is a smaller, boutique developer rather than one of Dubai's household-name master developers, and Amali Residences represents the kind of project that boutique developers increasingly use to differentiate themselves: rather than competing on scale or masterplan size against Emaar or Damac, the pitch here is architectural distinctiveness and a genuinely unusual unit typology that larger, more standardised developers rarely attempt. The Sky Villa concept, effectively a private villa's worth of space and outdoor living, mid-air, with its own pool, is a meaningful design risk that pays off specifically for buyers bored of the standard Dubai tower formula. For end-users, the appeal is straightforward, a genuinely distinctive home in one of Dubai's most established canal-front corridors, with private outdoor space most towers simply can't offer at any price. For buyers specifically chasing something more architecturally distinctive than the standard canal-front apartment product Dubai now has in abundance, Amali Residences occupies a genuinely uncrowded niche.

• Private pools (Sky Villas)
• Indoor & outdoor pools
• Yoga & Pilates studio
• Full gym
• Kids waterpark
• Canal & Downtown views

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 5% on initial booking
• 55% payable during construction
• 40% due upon handover

The payment plan runs a relatively front-loaded 5% on booking, 55% during construction and 40% on handover, with Q4 2029 as the handover target. Starting from around AED 10 million, this places Amali Residences firmly in the luxury tier rather than the mass or mid-market segment, a pricing level that reflects both the canal-front location and the genuinely differentiated product rather than pure floor area. Amenities lean firmly toward wellness and lifestyle rather than generic tower facilities: indoor and outdoor pools, a dedicated yoga and Pilates studio, a full gym, and a kids' waterpark, positioning the tower as a lifestyle-first address rather than a purely investment-grade unit stack aimed at yield-focused buyers. For investors, boutique developer projects like this carry a different risk profile than a flagship Emaar or Damac launch: smaller-scale developers can move faster and take more architectural risks, but buyers should weigh Amali's more limited track record against the larger master developers' extensive delivery history.
arancia-yards:
Arancia Yards is the first residential phase of 'The Yards,' a new masterplan from Beyond, Omniyat's dedicated residential-focused arm, distinct from the parent company's more famous ultra-luxury towers like The Opus and One Palm, set within City of Arabia in Dubailand. Studio to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom townhouses are arranged around a one-kilometre green spine that runs through the heart of the masterplan, along with sunken gardens and rooftop terraces, with more than 70% of the entire community designed as open-air living space rather than built form.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Beyond by Omniyat in City of Arabia, Dubailand
• Curated collection of Studio, 1BR Apartment, 2BR Apartment, 3BR Apartment, 3BR Townhouse
• Starting from approximately AED 1M
• Handover targeted for Q2 2029
• Signature amenities including 1km green spine, Sunken gardens, Rooftop terraces

### Architecture & Signature Residences

That 70%-plus open-space ratio is worth putting in context: it's an unusually generous allocation for a Dubai mid-to-upper-market launch, where developers typically maximise built floor area relative to available land. Beyond's decision to prioritise open space so heavily signals a deliberate positioning bet, that buyers in this segment increasingly value genuine outdoor living and greenery as much as, or more than, maximised indoor square footage, a shift in buyer priorities that's become increasingly visible across Dubai's newer launches generally. This matters for buyers specifically: Arancia Yards offers genuine Omniyat-level design credibility without requiring penthouse-level pricing, opening that design sensibility to a meaningfully larger pool of buyers than Omniyat's flagship towers have historically reached.

• 1km green spine
• Sunken gardens
• Rooftop terraces
• 70%+ open-air living space
• Community pools
• Kids play areas

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 10% on initial booking
• 30% payable during construction
• 60% due upon handover

The payment plan runs 10% on booking, 30% during construction and a substantial 60% on handover, a notably backloaded structure that keeps upfront and construction-period commitments comparatively light while placing the bulk of the payment at completion, useful for buyers who'd rather see the finished product before committing most of their capital. Starting from around AED 1 million for studios (with two- and three-bedroom units starting from roughly AED 2.1 million and AED 3.3 million respectively), and handover targeted for Q1 2029, Arancia Yards positions itself as a genuinely accessible entry point into design-led living.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

The Beyond brand itself represents Omniyat's attempt to bring the same design pedigree that's made The Opus and One Palm internationally recognised architectural landmarks to a more accessible price point and broader product type than the parent company's ultra-luxury back catalogue. For buyers who want Omniyat's architectural reputation and Beyond's genuinely generous open-space masterplanning, without the ultra-luxury price tag the Omniyat name usually commands, Arancia Yards is one of the more interesting propositions currently in Dubailand's fast-growing City of Arabia district.
athlon:
Athlon is Aldar's first major residential play in Dubai, developed in partnership with Dubai Holding as a roughly 2,692-unit, 119-hectare wellness and active-living masterplan in Dubailand, directly adjacent to the well-established Arabian Ranches 3 community. One- to three-bedroom apartments sit alongside three- and four-bedroom townhomes and three- to six-bedroom villas, all organised around running and bike tracks, sports courts and yoga spaces that connect directly into Dubai's existing 86km Al Qudra Cycle Track, genuine, already-built infrastructure rather than a rendering promise, which is a meaningful point of difference from many competing wellness-branded launches that promise trails and tracks still years from completion.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Aldar Properties (with Dubai Holding) in Dubailand, next to Arabian Ranches 3
• Curated collection of 1BR Apartment, 3BR Townhome, 4BR Townhome, 3BR Villa, 6BR Villa
• Starting from approximately AED 2.8M
• Handover targeted for Q3 2028
• Signature amenities including Running & bike tracks, Connects to 86km Al Qudra Cycle Track, Sports courts

### Architecture & Signature Residences

This project carries real strategic significance beyond its own scale: Aldar is Abu Dhabi's dominant master developer, and Athlon represents the company's first substantial move into Dubai's residential market after years of near-total focus on Abu Dhabi. Partnering with Dubai Holding for this launch gives Aldar an established local partner with deep Dubai market knowledge and existing infrastructure relationships, while positioning Athlon as something of a test case for whether Aldar can compete directly with Emaar and Dubai Holding's own developments on their home turf rather than remaining primarily an Abu Dhabi story. For buyers, Athlon offers a genuinely interesting proposition: Aldar's Abu Dhabi delivery reputation and balance sheet, backed by Dubai Holding's local market presence, applied to a wellness-and-active-lifestyle concept with real, already-built connective infrastructure via the Al Qudra Cycle Track rather than a standalone trail system built in isolation.

• Running & bike tracks
• Connects to 86km Al Qudra Cycle Track
• Sports courts
• Yoga spaces
• Community pools
• Kids play areas

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 5% on initial booking
• 55% payable during construction
• 40% due upon handover

The payment plan runs 5% on booking, 55% during construction and 40% on handover, though alternative structures by unit type are also marketed, including 10/50/40 and lighter 10/60/30 and 10/70/20 splits, giving buyers meaningful choice in how they structure payments depending on their own cash flow preferences.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

Handover is targeted for Q3 2028, and starting prices around AED 2.8 million position Athlon competitively against neighbouring Arabian Ranches and Dubai Hills product, effectively undercutting or matching established Emaar and Dubai Holding villa communities in the same general corridor. For investors specifically, Athlon's success or failure as Aldar's first major Dubai residential launch carries broader significance, a strong reception here likely signals further Aldar expansion into Dubai, which could benefit early buyers through the kind of brand-momentum effect that's boosted resale values for early entrants into other developers' first major community launches in new markets.
azizi-florence:

The community offers a diverse collection of 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses, 4, 5 and 6-bedroom villas, along with future apartment residences, providing spacious homes with modern finishes, private outdoor areas, and layouts designed for comfortable family living.

bayn:
Bayn is ORA Developers' flagship UAE community, a 9,000-residence coastal masterplan in Ghantoot, the stretch of coastline directly between Dubai and Abu Dhabi, built around more than 7km of waterfront, a marina, and a full suite of sports facilities. Three- to eight-bedroom villas, townhouses and mansions are planned across multiple phases, with the first release targeting completion by December 2028, positioning Bayn as a genuine long-term land play on one of the last substantial undeveloped waterfront corridors within practical reach of both emirates.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by ORA Developers in Ghantoot, between Dubai & Abu Dhabi
• Curated collection of 3BR Villa, 4BR Townhouse, 6BR Villa, 8BR Mansion
• Starting from approximately AED 2.8M
• Handover targeted for Dec 2028 (Phase 1)
• Signature amenities including 7km+ waterfront, Marina, Sports facilities

### Architecture & Signature Residences

ORA Developers is led by Egyptian billionaire Naguib Sawiris, and the company has built a strong reputation in Egypt for large-scale coastal and golf-anchored communities, projects at a genuinely masterplan scale rather than single towers or boutique developments. Bayn represents ORA's most significant UAE bet to date, and the company is clearly applying the same large-scale, amenity-first masterplanning approach that's worked in its Egyptian portfolio to a market where it's still establishing its brand and track record. For buyers comfortable taking an early position in a masterplan that will take years to fully mature, in the way early buyers into Dubai Creek Harbour or The Valley eventually benefited from years of subsequent infrastructure investment, Bayn offers precisely that kind of ground-floor opportunity, backed by a developer with genuine large-scale delivery experience even if that experience comes primarily from outside the UAE.

• 7km+ waterfront
• Marina
• Sports facilities
• Waterfront promenades
• Community parks
• Retail & dining

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 20% on initial booking
• 40% payable during construction
• 40% due upon handover

The payment plan runs 20% on booking, 40% during construction and 40% on handover, an evenly weighted structure that splits risk fairly between buyer and developer across the build timeline; an alternative plan is also offered, with a lighter 10% booking, 50% during construction and 40% on handover paid via quarterly instalments of roughly 3.2% each, giving buyers more flexibility in how they manage cash flow. Starting from around AED 2.75 million, it's priced to reflect both the early-phase risk and the scale of the long-term opportunity.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

Ghantoot's location is the central strategic bet behind Bayn: it's one of the very few remaining stretches of UAE coastline not already built out by a major master developer, sitting at a genuine crossroads between Dubai's and Abu Dhabi's respective job markets, retail, and lifestyle infrastructure. That position cuts both ways, buyers get access to both emirates without being fully committed to either, but they're also betting on infrastructure and connectivity continuing to improve along that corridor as the masterplan itself develops over what will likely be a multi-year, multi-phase build-out.
bayz-102:
Bayz 102 is a 103-storey Danube Properties tower in Business Bay, the taller follow-up to the developer's original Bayz 101, and currently one of the tallest residential addresses in the entire district, a genuine height statement in a part of Dubai already known for supertall towers.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Danube Properties in Business Bay
• Curated collection of Studio, 1BR Apartment, 2BR Apartment, 3BR Apartment, 4BR Apartment, Penthouse
• Starting from approximately AED 1.4M
• Handover targeted for Dec 2029
• Signature amenities including Fully furnished units, Community pool, Gym

### Architecture & Signature Residences

Studio to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses are delivered to Danube's now well-established, signature fully furnished, turnkey standard, meaning owners can move in or start renting immediately without the additional cost, time and hassle of separately furnishing the unit. Community pool, gym and landscaped decks round out the building's amenity offering, solid, functional facilities rather than headline-grabbing extras, consistent with Danube's positioning as an accessible, value-focused option rather than a luxury or design-led brand. For buyers who want height and Business Bay's genuinely central location without the premium pricing that branded or design-led towers nearby command, Bayz 102 is pitched precisely at that gap, backed by Danube's now extensive and largely reliable track record of on-time, furnished handovers across dozens of previous Dubai projects, a track record that matters considerably more for a project of this scale and structural complexity than it would for a smaller, lower-rise building.

• Fully furnished units
• Community pool
• Gym
• Landscaped decks
• Retail nearby
• 24/7 security

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 10% on initial booking
• 59% payable during construction

Danube Properties has built its business specifically around this formula across more than a decade of Dubai apartment towers: accessible entry prices, flexible instalment-based payment plans, and furnished handovers that let investors start generating rental income essentially immediately upon completion. The payment plan runs 10% on booking, 59% during construction and a token 1% at literal handover, with a substantial 30% structured as a post-handover payment plan spread across 30 months, an unusually buyer-friendly structure that lets owners move in and, in an investor's case, potentially start collecting rent while continuing to pay down nearly a third of the purchase price over more than two years after taking possession. Bayz 102 applies that same proven model at supertall scale, betting that the combination of genuine height, Business Bay's central location and Danube's furnished-handover convenience will appeal to the same investor base that's made the company's other towers reliable, high-volume sellers. Starting from around AED 1.38 million, with handover reported inconsistently across sources, some citing December 2029, others a considerably earlier June or Q2 2029, buyers should confirm the specific date directly before committing.
binghatti-skyrise:
Binghatti Skyrise is three 48-storey, diamond-crowned towers in Business Bay, continuing the angular, sculptural design language that has made Binghatti one of Dubai's most instantly recognisable developer brands over the past several years, buildings that are genuinely identifiable as Binghatti projects from a distance, a rare achievement in a market where much new construction can look interchangeable. Binghatti's rise over the past several years has been built on a specific combination: bold, easily marketable architecture, genuinely rapid construction pace relative to many competitors, and a series of high-profile brand collaborations (most notably with Bugatti) that have generated outsized marketing attention relative to the company's actual unit volume.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Binghatti Developers in Business Bay
• Curated collection of 1BR Apartment, 2BR Apartment, 3BR Apartment
• Starting from approximately AED 975K
• Handover targeted for Dec 2026
• Signature amenities including Pool, Gym, Yoga zone

### Architecture & Signature Residences

That combination has translated into strong, consistent resale and rental performance across the company's completed towers, giving newer launches like Skyrise the benefit of an increasingly proven track record to point to. Skyrise sits at a considerably more accessible price point than Binghatti's headline branded collaborations like the Bugatti or Jacob & Co. It's a well-located, well-priced apartment play from a developer with an increasingly proven delivery record, rather than a bet on any single novel concept.

• Pool

• 20% on initial booking
• 50% payable during construction

For buyers specifically weighing Binghatti's standard apartment product against its branded-collaboration towers, Skyrise represents the more straightforward, lower-risk entry point into the brand: the same design language, the same construction track record, and Business Bay's same locational advantages, without the added resale uncertainty that branded-residence premiums can carry if buyer appetite for that specific brand association shifts over time. With handover targeted for December 2026, Skyrise also offers a considerably shorter wait than many of the longer-horizon masterplan launches elsewhere in this portfolio, which matters for investors specifically weighing the opportunity cost of capital tied up in an off-plan purchase against the alternative of buying ready secondary-market stock in the same building's completed sister towers nearby.

One- to three-bedroom apartments come with Burj Khalifa views from many units, a location advantage Business Bay has consistently offered relative to its price point compared with Downtown Dubai proper, supported by a pool, gym, yoga zone and kids' area typical of Binghatti's mid-to-upper apartment product across its broader portfolio.
bugatti-residences:
Bugatti Residences is Binghatti's licensed collaboration with the French ultra-luxury automaker, a high-profile tower in Business Bay that translates Bugatti's automotive design language, sculpted, aerodynamic forms, carbon-fibre-inspired detailing, and motion-inspired interior concepts, directly into two- to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses, making it one of the most talked-about branded-residence launches in Dubai since the automotive-and-fashion branded residence trend accelerated sharply over the past several years. This collaboration represents a genuinely significant coup for Binghatti: Bugatti is among the most exclusive automotive brands globally, and licensing that name for a residential tower signals a level of brand partnership well beyond what most developers achieve.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Binghatti Developers (licensed collaboration with Bugatti) in Business Bay
• Curated collection of 2BR Apartment, 3BR Apartment, 4BR Apartment, Penthouse
• Starting from approximately AED 19M
• Handover targeted for Q3 2027
• Signature amenities including Automotive-inspired design, Sky pool, Wellness amenities

### Architecture & Signature Residences

• Developed by Emaar in Dubai Creek Harbour
• Curated collection of Apartments
• Starting from approximately AED 2.0M
• Handover targeted for 31 Dec 2030
• Signature amenities including Central A/C, Gym, Luxury and High-end Finishing

### Architecture & Signature Residences

Located along the historic Dubai Creek, the development combines contemporary architecture, thoughtfully planned residences, landscaped surroundings, and a vibrant waterfront lifestyle, creating a balanced environment between urban convenience and natural open spaces. Residents can enjoy a range of lifestyle amenities including swimming pools, fitness facilities, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, leisure spaces, community areas, and walking and cycling paths, while the wider Dubai Creek Harbour community offers waterfront promenades, restaurants, retail destinations, parks, and entertainment venues. As part of Emaar’s flagship waterfront master community, the development benefits from the area’s expanding infrastructure, modern urban planning, and growing residential and lifestyle offerings.

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

Valia features modern apartments with spacious layouts, open-plan living areas, floor-to-ceiling windows, private balconies, premium finishes, and views of the surrounding landscape and Dubai skyline, with residences designed to suit professionals, families, and investors.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

Strategically positioned within Dubai Creek Harbour, Valia provides convenient connectivity to major destinations including Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa, Dubai International Airport, Dubai Festival City, Business Bay, and Dubai Marina. valo:
Valo is a 285-unit eco-concept development within Emaar's Dubai Creek Harbour, built around water-conservation systems, smart lighting and shaded balconies specifically engineered to reduce energy consumption without compromising on the waterfront views that define the wider Creek Harbour masterplan.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Emaar Properties in Dubai Creek Harbour
• Curated collection of 1BR Apartment, 2BR Apartment, 3BR Townhouse
• Starting from approximately AED 1.8M
• Handover targeted for Q3 2028
• Signature amenities including Eco-tech water conservation, Smart lighting, Shaded balconies

### Architecture & Signature Residences

One- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom townhouses sit close to Creek Harbour's growing retail and marina precinct, with the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a genuine, protected natural habitat home to flamingos and other migratory birds, and the future Dubai Creek Tower skyline both forming part of the backdrop. What distinguishes Valo from simply being another Creek Harbour apartment building with 'eco' in its marketing copy is that the sustainability features are integrated at the building-systems level, water conservation and smart lighting infrastructure built into the structure itself, rather than being a surface-level label applied to an otherwise standard tower. For buyers who want exposure to Dubai Creek Harbour's long-term growth story, a masterplan many expect to mature into a genuine second downtown over the coming decade as Dubai Creek Tower and the surrounding retail and marina infrastructure complete, but who also want a lower environmental footprint than a typical Dubai tower offers, Valo occupies a specific and currently underserved niche.

• Eco-tech water conservation
• Smart lighting
• Shaded balconies
• Gym
• Wellness zones
• Community pool

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 10% on initial booking
• 80% payable during construction
• 10% due upon handover

The payment plan runs a front-loaded 10% on booking and 80% during construction, with a light 10% due on handover, a structure that asks buyers to commit the bulk of their payment across the build period but keeps the final handover payment manageable, useful for buyers who want most of their financial commitment settled well before move-in.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

Dubai Creek Harbour is one of Emaar's most ambitious ongoing masterplans, envisioned as a new downtown-scale district built around the Dubai Creek waterway, and Valo represents one of the more environmentally-focused entries within that broader development. Handover is targeted for Q3 2028, and starting prices from around AED 1.79 million for apartments (with townhouses starting significantly higher, from roughly AED 4.86 million) position Valo's apartment component as one of the more accessible entry points into the broader Creek Harbour masterplan. The combination of genuine sustainability engineering, Emaar's own delivery track record, and Creek Harbour's broader growth trajectory makes this one of the more differentiated apartment options within an otherwise increasingly crowded Creek Harbour launch pipeline, appealing specifically to environmentally-conscious buyers who don't want to sacrifice location or developer pedigree to find that positioning.
volga-tower:
Volga Tower is a 40- to 46-storey residential tower from Tiger Properties in Jumeirah Village Triangle, styled after Russia's Volga River and continuing the developer's broader pattern of geography- and landmark-themed naming across its portfolio, a naming and design philosophy that gives Tiger Properties' buildings a distinct identity relative to the more generically-named towers that dominate much of JVT and neighbouring JVC.

### Key Highlights

• Developed by Tiger Properties in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT)
• Curated collection of 1BR Apartment, 2BR Apartment, 3BR Apartment, 4BR Apartment
• Starting from approximately AED 1.4M
• Handover targeted for Q4 2026
• Signature amenities including Private pool per unit, Gym, Community pool

### Architecture & Signature Residences

One- to four-bedroom apartments each come with a private pool, Tiger's standard differentiator across its JVT and JVC product, mirroring the private-pool strategy Samana Developers has used with similar success in Arjan and Majan, and a feature that's become an effective way for mid-market developers in these competitive apartment corridors to stand out without necessarily competing purely on price per square foot, since a private pool represents a tangible, immediately visible amenity upgrade over a standard shared-pool building.

• Private pool per unit
• Gym
• Community pool
• Kids play areas
• Retail nearby
• 24/7 security

### Payment Structure & Investment Profile

• 10% on initial booking
• 32% payable during construction
• 10% due upon handover
• Extended post-handover payment plan available

The payment plan runs 10% on booking, 32% during construction and a light 10% at handover, with the remaining 48% structured as a genuinely extended post-handover payment plan spread out to 2030, effectively an interest-free financing arrangement stretching roughly seven years from initial booking, a notably buyer-friendly structure that significantly reduces the upfront and near-term capital required relative to most comparable JVT and JVC launches. Starting from around AED 1.4 million, with handover targeted for Q4 2026, a genuinely near-term completion date, Volga Tower competes in JVT's increasingly crowded but still comparatively affordable apartment market. JVT's comparatively lower density than JVC also means less immediate retail and dining directly on the doorstep, a trade-off buyers should weigh against the area's quieter, more residential feel and the private-pool amenity that Tiger has built its JVT and JVC reputation on, for tenants specifically prioritising a private outdoor space over ground-floor retail convenience, that trade-off tends to work in the landlord's favour.

### Location & Strategic Connectivity

Jumeirah Village Triangle, JVC's quieter and somewhat less densely built neighbour, has followed a similar trajectory of rapid apartment-tower development over recent years, drawing many of the same value-focused, yield-driven investors that have made JVC one of Dubai's highest-volume rental markets. For buyers specifically weighing Volga Tower against the dozens of competing towers in this corridor, the combination of a private pool in every unit and an unusually extended, buyer-friendly payment structure running years beyond handover gives Tiger Properties a genuine point of differentiation in a market segment where most competing projects look broadly similar on paper, and where payment-plan flexibility alone can meaningfully sway a value-focused investor's final decision.
